_meta.subject: Jump (jump.ai)
_meta.purpose: Structured extraction of Jump's public marketing & product claims for the Jump vs Keepance competitive analysis.
_meta.method: WebFetch/WebSearch of public Jump pages (robots.txt allows general crawl) + two independent research subagents + an independent Codex investigation. All claims are Jump's MARKETING unless tagged third_party_verified. No auth/paywall bypassed.

verification_legend.marketing_claim: Jump's own assertion; not independently verified.
verification_legend.third_party_verified: Corroborated by a source independent of Jump (Kitces, Ezra Group, App Store, trade press, investor sites).
verification_legend.self_reported_repeated_by_press: Originates with Jump; trade press repeated it without independent audit.

_meta.limitations: security.jump.ai trust center is JS/Vanta-gated (no readable text via public fetch); SOC 2 Type II/Iowa-hosting/Vanta facts come from Jump's help-center FAQ and the jump-vs-zocks page, not the gated portal. Reddit (r/CFP) and G2/Capterra star pages were blocked to automated agents. T3 survey primary + some comparison tables are paywalled. Churn/retention and add-on attach rate are non-public.

pages.headline: The #1 AI platform for advisors!
pages.subhead: Trusted AI for advisors & financial professionals. Save time, increase revenue, and elevate the client experience with compliant AI.
pages.category_positioning: AI operating system / AI platform for financial advisors (NOT positioned as 'just a notetaker').
pages.implied_category: Advisor AI operating system / advisor workflow platform
pages.implied_buyer: RIA principal, enterprise broker-dealer/IBD, independent advisor
pages.implied_pain: Time lost to meeting admin, manual notetaking, CRM data entry, scattered client data, missed growth opportunities

product_feature_claims.claim: Ask questions and take action across your tech stack
Evergreen client profiles that pull data across all data sources
Faster drafting and rewrites, right in your inbox
Meeting notes, decisions, next steps; pre-meeting prep auto-brief; post-meeting CRM data sync; auto follow-up emails & tasks; meeting scheduling
Signals (opportunities/risks), Playbooks, Scorecards, Pulse & Surveys, Dashboards
AI Intake Forms + Document Intelligence (upload, parse, sync documents)

social_proof.claim: Empowering 35,000+ advisors at top firms of all sizes
social_proof.note: Was '27,000+ advisors' at Feb 2026 Series B; June 25 2026 release softened to '35,000+ users worldwide'.
Enterprise distribution real: Cetera ~12,000 advisors, LPL ~23,000-advisor vendor affinity program, Focus Financial ~800.

social_proof.claim: #1 in Market Share and Customer Satisfaction; rated #1 across T3, Kitces, and The Oasis Group reports
social_proof.note: Kitces Research ~10% adoption = clear #1 standalone AI notetaker; 2025 T3 survey top honors (transcription 8.61; onboarding/proposal-gen 8.64). App Store 4.9/5, ~1,100 ratings.

social_proof.claim: 10 hrs saved per advisor per week; 2.1x increase in growth opportunities; 42% reduction in outstanding client service tasks
social_proof.note: Company-reported metrics; no independent efficacy data.

compliance_claims: Recording is optional; transcript-only / summary-only / full A/V configurable
Client data never trains our models
Every AI-generated output is reviewable before it goes anywhere (human-in-the-loop)
Configurable to match firm supervision and record-keeping policies; client disclosure, consent, supervision
ctas: Book a demo to get started

pages.headline_definition: An AI agent that runs your workflow so you don't have to
pages.category_positioning: Agentic assistant layer of the 'operating system'; included in all plans

product_feature_claims.claim: Ask questions and take action across your tech stack
Update records. Draft emails. Assign tasks. Schedule meetings from a single conversation
Every action requires your approval and follows your firm's compliance settings
Reads your transcripts and meeting notes and surfaces the answer with the source attached
product_feature_claims.note: CITED answers — but emphasis is transcripts/meeting notes.

product_feature_claims.claim: Synthesizes data into a single, coherent brief

example_queries: What's the Hendersons' current asset allocation?
Which clients over 60 don't have a beneficiary on file?
pages.maturity_note: Jump's own help center calls AI Associate 'early access'; chat history 'coming soon' (per independent Codex investigation of help.jumpapp.com). Treat as live-but-maturing.
pages.strategic_implication: DIRECT overlap with Keepance 'Ask' + 'Client Map'. Jump markets cited cross-source Q&A and a 'coherent brief' — but sourced from meetings/CRM/integrated-systems, not a deep read of an arbitrary document/email folder. Cloud-only.

pages.headline: Experience the AI platform built for advisors and financial professionals

pricing_claims.note: Cut from $120 to $100 (and $75 for small firms) ~2026 — read by analysts as competitive pressure.
pricing_claims.includes: AI notetaker, unlimited meetings, pre-meeting prep, follow-up tasks/emails, CRM + planning sync, meeting scheduling, free trial
AI account opening, form completion, document intake, CRM field mapping
meeting analytics, topics/trends, proactive recommendations, coaching, revenue sourcing
API/build, SSO, custom attestations, SCIM/SAML, compliance dashboard, custom disclosures

pricing_terms: Monthly or annual (save up to 20% annually)
40+ integrations, AI Associate, MCP, automations included in all plans
pages.loaded_seat: A fully-loaded seat (Meet+Onboard+Grow) ≈ $200/advisor/mo; InvestmentNews cites ~$75 basic to ~$120 premium; 5-10x generic notetakers (Fireflies).

pages.headline: Integrates with your technology
pages.verification: marketing_claim (count) / third_party_verified (breadth is a genuine strength per Ezra Group integration score 8.63)
pages.strategic_implication: Integration breadth is a Jump strength and a Keepance gap (Keepance has ~2 polished: OneDrive + Wealthbox). But note: only ONE true custodian (Schwab); 'custodian' partners are mostly broker-dealers/IBDs.

compliance_claims: Flexible capture and retention controls (summary-only mode, no stored audio/video)
Human review before system actions (advisor attestation before CRM syncs, communications, exports)
Consent and disclosure management (transcript detection, firm-defined disclosures)
Data protection safeguards (automatic redaction, copy/download restrictions)
Designed for RIA and Broker-Dealer compliance workflows

verified_security_facts.source: Jump help-center FAQ + jump-vs-zocks page (trust center itself JS-gated)
facts: Encryption in transit and at rest
No customer data used to train models
Zero-transcript-retention mode disables some features (e.g. Ask Anything)

pages.strategic_implication: Strong ENTERPRISE-SaaS compliance posture — but it is cloud. 'Delete/retain controls' and 'we don't train on your data' is NOT the same as Keepance's 'data never leaves your machine / BYOK-direct'. This is the genuine, defensible seam.

positioning_claims: Jump market share 22.68% vs Zocks 10.22% (Jump's citation)
Ezra Group WealthTech Integration Score: Jump 8.63 vs Zocks 8.14
'Note-taking is table stakes'; value is in revenue intelligence + workflow execution
pages.strategic_implication: Reveals Jump considers Zocks its main rival and is racing UP-market into 'operating system / revenue intelligence'. Confirms notetaking is now table-stakes — Keepance must NOT enter as a notetaker.

product_feature_claims.claim: Pull from emails, documents, planning tools, and meetings in one place
Extend from insight into trusted, controlled action across your connected systems

pages.depth_finding: Documents ARE listed as a source, but the page's emphasis and proof are meeting-derived intelligence + integrated-system data (CRM/email/calendar). No example of deep multi-document synthesis across a client's full file room.
pages.strategic_implication: Confirms Jump's synthesis center-of-gravity is meetings + connected SaaS, not an arbitrary local document pile.

claims.claim: Document Intelligence: upload, parse, and sync documents
claims.note: Oriented to account-opening / form-filling / intake — extracting fields to populate forms and CRM — NOT retrospective synthesis of an existing document collection.

pages.strategic_implication: Jump's document handling is intake/extraction, confirming the document-depth seam for Keepance is real (though narrowing as Jump invests).

claims: AI Associate now on iOS (conversational queries + cross-system actions)
AI Assistant embedded inside Redtail's interface
Pre-Meeting Prep now ingests Redtail comment threads + custom User Defined Fields
Signals can create Salesforce opportunities / send emails inline
pages.roadmap_direction: Mobile-first; deepening embedded intelligence INSIDE partner CRMs; synthesis deepening over CRM fields/comments (not document piles).
pages.strategic_implication: Jump's momentum is breadth (mobile, embed-in-CRM, more integrations), reinforcing the seam that it deepens around connected systems, not local files.

others: angels Hans Tung, Ryan Anderson, Aaron Skonnard

verified_facts.adoption_independent: Kitces Research: ~10% of all US advisors use Jump (clear #1 standalone AI notetaker); App Store 4.9/5 (~1,100 ratings)
verified_facts.complaints_independent: Dropped recordings ('failure rate unacceptable'); note-accuracy glitches; XYPN scored note accuracy 3.5/5 (below FinMate)
